test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 30 Jun 2023 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: After offering two successive discounts of 10% each, the seller earns 10% profit. The cost price is what per cent (rounded off to 2 decimal places) of the tag price?
solution:
**Given:**

Two successive discount = 10%

Profit = 10 %

Formula used:

Effective discount = D% + D% - (D²/100)

C.P/M.P = {100 - D%}/{100 + P%} 

Where, C.P = cost price ; M.P = Marked price

D = discount ; P = profit

**Calculation:**

Effective rate = D% + D% - (D2/100)

⇒ 10 + 10 - {(10)²/100}

⇒ 20 - 1 = 19%

C.P/M.P = {100 - D%}/{100 + P%} 

⇒ (100 - 19)/(100 + 10)

⇒ 81/110 

C.P : M.P = 81 : 110

Required percentage = (81 × 100)/110

⇒ 810/11 = 73.636 ≈ 73.64%

**∴ The correct answer is 73.64%.**
